_comment: The static RAM (.data and .bss) that the objects under src/ui/angulo define, a high-water mark in the manner of flash_budget.json. tools/check_ui_ram.py adds it up from the nm -S listing of each object after every build of an image that carries the Angulo and holds the total to "budget" exactly: growing past it is allowed, doing so without editing it in the same change is not, and a build that shrinks lowers it in the same change (a budget that only rises stops measuring). The heap pays for every byte: the telemetry batch drops to one entry below HEAP_RESERVE (TelemetryManager.cpp), 32,768 B with TLS telemetry. Padding between objects is not counted.
